capabilities.name: 产品页面 / UI-UX 设计
capabilities.summary: 把一个产品介绍、落地页或界面需求，变成有设计系统、用户文案、可访问性和响应式验收的页面。
probe: 确认产品/公司是什么，不要凭空编一个品牌
确认受众、主 CTA 和真实下一步
确认已有品牌资产/文案/图片；没有就明确用占位内容
检查现有设计系统、技术栈和已装技能

candidates.name: ui-ux-pro-max
candidates.notes: design-system generator and UX checklist; register/adapt before use

candidates.name: frontend-design
candidates.notes: visual direction and frontend design guidance

candidates.name: impeccable
candidates.notes: UI/UX review, polish and edge-case checks

candidates.name: existing project design system
candidates.notes: prefer existing tokens and components over a new framework

candidates.name: hand-written minimal HTML/CSS
candidates.notes: only when no design system or skill fits; record why the candidates were rejected

verification: brief complete: product name, one-line description, three capabilities, primary CTA; none may be placeholder
no placeholder tokens in user-facing content (【】/占位/待填/TODO/lorem ipsum/example.com)
real 390/768/1440 screenshots; scrollWidth <= clientWidth at every width (browser action=audit on the preview URL with allow_loopback=true)
contrast and tap targets (mobile tap targets >= 44px)
real CTA, not example.com or a placeholder mailto
unslop / web-ui-audit / impeccable findings and fixes recorded
fallback: ask for the missing brief fields and wait; do not substitute placeholders unless the user explicitly chose a prototype
return conditional with the design gaps

capabilities.name: UI 优化与验收 / Unslop
capabilities.summary: 把 AI 味、模板感、排版和交互问题修掉，并在交付前做可量化的页面验收。
probe: 先读设计 brief：产品/受众/CTA/品牌资产
检查首屏、CTA、价格/证言等是否齐全
扫描 AI-slop 特征：紫色渐变、渐变文字、发光、emoji 图标、均匀卡片、空泛口号

candidates.name: unslop
candidates.notes: ~/.hermes/skills/creative/unslop/SKILL.md; read and follow; keep attribution

candidates.name: web-ui-audit
candidates.notes: ~/.hermes/skills/software-development/web-ui-audit/SKILL.md; audit plus page-audit script

candidates.name: impeccable
candidates.notes: UI/UX review and polish

candidates.name: manual design checklist
candidates.notes: fallback when no review skill can be used

verification: real CTA, not example.com or a placeholder mailto
AI-slop checklist cleared or explicitly accepted
fallback: return conditional with the remaining visual gaps

capabilities.name: OCR / 图片与扫描件转文字
capabilities.summary: 从图片或扫描 PDF 提取文字，保留可用的阅读顺序、版面和置信度。
probe: 用 pdffonts/pdftotext 判断 PDF 是否已有文本层
确认语言、手写、版面、隐私和批量要求
如果已有文本层，不要上 OCR

candidates.name: tesseract
candidates.notes: local, CPU, good baseline; language packs matter

candidates.name: paddleocr
candidates.notes: local, strong Chinese/layout support, GPU optional

candidates.name: easyocr
candidates.notes: local, many languages, heavier runtime

candidates.name: ocrmypdf
candidates.notes: produces searchable PDF; depends on Tesseract

candidates.name: cloud OCR
candidates.notes: high accuracy, network/cost/privacy review required

fallback: cloud OCR with explicit data approval
human review for handwriting or low-quality scans

capabilities.name: PDF → HTML
capabilities.summary: 把 PDF 转成可读的 HTML 和资源，保留文字、链接、图片，以及必要的版面结构。
probe: 判断文本版还是扫描版
检查分栏、表格、公式、图片和链接
确认要文字保真还是版面保真

candidates.name: pdftohtml
candidates.notes: fast text/layout baseline; output can be rough

candidates.name: pdf2htmlEX
candidates.notes: layout-preserving HTML; heavier output

candidates.name: mutool
candidates.notes: convert/draw/extract; check AGPL implications

candidates.name: docling
candidates.notes: layout-aware document conversion

candidates.name: marker
candidates.notes: PDF to Markdown/HTML, layout and tables; GPU optional

candidates.name: cloud document AI
candidates.notes: high fidelity, network/cost/privacy review required

fallback: text-first extraction when layout is not required
OCR first when the PDF is scanned
human layout review for high-fidelity publishing

capabilities.name: 音频 / 视频音轨转文字
capabilities.summary: 把音频或视频音轨转成带时间戳的文字，必要时区分说话人。
probe: 用 ffprobe 确认采样率、声道、时长和编码
确认语言、多人、时间戳和实时性要求
确认本地还是云端，数据能否离开机器

candidates.name: whisper.cpp
candidates.notes: local, CPU/GPU, good baseline; model download and size matter

candidates.name: faster-whisper
candidates.notes: faster local inference; GPU optional

candidates.name: vosk
candidates.notes: lightweight local ASR; model per language

candidates.name: cloud ASR
candidates.notes: strong accuracy/diarization, network/cost/privacy review required

candidates.name: human transcription
candidates.notes: best for noisy, multi-speaker or high-stakes recordings

fallback: cloud ASR with explicit data approval

capabilities.name: 视频剪辑 / 转码
capabilities.summary: 按指令裁剪、拼接、转码、加字幕或生成短视频，并验证输出媒体。
probe: 用 ffprobe 检查编码、帧率、时长、分辨率和音轨
确认目标平台、时长、比例和字幕要求
判断是机械剪辑还是需要创意剪辑

candidates.name: ffmpeg
candidates.notes: cut/concat/transcode/subtitle baseline; not a creative editor

candidates.name: moviepy
candidates.notes: programmatic compositing; slower for long videos

candidates.name: remotion
candidates.notes: React-based programmatic video; good for templated clips

candidates.name: cloud video API
candidates.notes: transcode/transcribe/render; network/cost/privacy review required

candidates.name: human editor
candidates.notes: best for creative pacing, story and taste

verification: codec/container/resolution are playable on the target
spot-check the first/last frame and a random middle frame
fallback: split/transcode only when creative editing is out of scope
